subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “Another came in to ask about a poster.”?
options: Soon, other students began to think differently about the front row.
Students may read, borrow books, or work quietly at the tables.
Then students began thanking cleaners, guards, kitchen workers, and bus drivers.
Soon, students began staying to draw, paint, or simply sit quietly.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「Soon, other students began to think differently about the front row.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Students may read, borrow books, or work quietly at the tables.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Then students began thanking cleaners, guards, kitchen workers, and bus drivers.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Another came in to ask about a poster. Soon, students began staying to draw, paint, or simply sit quietly.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Another came in to ask about a poster. Soon, students began staying to draw, paint, or simply sit quietly.」，答案為「Soon, students began staying to draw, paint, or simply sit quietly.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Soon, students began staying to draw, paint, or simply sit quietly.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
